description: This file is a header file defining configuration-related functions for the WLD component within the project. It contains function declarations for retrieving an enable sync mode string and checking if sync is needed.

methods.name: wld_config_getEnableSyncModeStr
methods.description: Returns a string representing whether sync mode is enabled.

methods.name: wld_config_isEnableSyncNeeded
methods.description: Determines whether sync is needed based on a boolean parameter.
